summary.text: Angie Button is a Republican state representative from Texas who has represented District 112 since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a certified public accountant who works as a marketing manager with Texas Instruments.

paragraphs.text: Angie Chen Button earned a master's degree in public finance and management services from the University of Texas at Dallas.
She works as a marketing manager with Texas Instruments and is a certified public accountant.
Button assumed office in the Texas House in 2009.
In 2021 through 2024 she chaired the International Relations & Economic Development Committee and also served on the Ways & Means Committee.
